annotation.title_clean: Stratégie nationale pour l'intelligence artificielle – 2e phase
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence – Phase 2
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement français (Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Relance; Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation; Secrétariat d'État chargé de la Transition numérique; SGPI)
annotation.summary_en: French government's second-phase national AI strategy under France 2030, committing €2.22bn over five years (€1.5bn public), mostly for AI training and talent, plus support for embedded, frugal and trustworthy AI and AI diffusion in the economy. Robotics is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: €2.22bn total over five years, including €1.5bn public funding and €506M private co-financing
More than half of public funds go to AI training and talent attraction
Target of 10–15% of the global embedded AI market by 2025
Support for trustworthy AI technologies to evaluate, audit and certify algorithms
Governance via SGPI and a public-private ecosystem partnership led by French Tech
